title: Claim
description: A statement or assertion made by an NPC, which may or may not be truthful.

speaker_npc_id.description: Reference to the NPC who made this claim.

content.description: The textual content of the claim.

truth_status.description: Objective truth classification of the claim.

speaker_believes_it.description: Whether the speaker genuinely believes this claim to be true.

available_when.description: Tags or conditions under which this claim becomes available.

forbidden_when.description: Tags or conditions under which this claim must be withheld.

strength.description: Weight of this claim for deduction scoring (1=weak, 3=strong).
